<style id="cdqV2220ViewportLock">
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device),
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) body{
  width:100%!important;
  max-width:100%!important;
  min-width:0!important;
  margin:0!important;
  padding-left:0!important;
  padding-right:0!important;
  overflow-x:hidden!important;
  box-sizing:border-box!important;
}

html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .container{
  min-width:0!important;
  box-sizing:border-box!important;
  overflow-x:hidden!important;
}

html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .app-header,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .top-bar,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .company-wrapper,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .quick-buttons,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) #cdqTopActionsV2204,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) #clientInfoBar,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) #filesContainer,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) #cdqInlineDisplayPanelV2204{
  width:100%!important;
  min-width:0!important;
  max-width:100%!important;
  box-sizing:border-box!important;
}

html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .company-wrapper{
  display:flex!important;
  gap:7px!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
}

html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .company-button{
  flex:1 1 0!important;
  width:auto!important;
  min-width:0!important;
  max-width:100%!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
  text-overflow:ellipsis!important;
  white-space:nowrap!important;
}

html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .company-reset-button{
  flex:0 0 48px!important;
  width:48px!important;
  min-width:48px!important;
  max-width:48px!important;
}

html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .quick-buttons,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) #cdqTopActionsV2204{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
  gap:7px!important;
}

html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .quick-button,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) #cdqTopActionsV2204 > .cdq-top-action{
  width:100%!important;
  min-width:0!important;
  max-width:100%!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
  box-sizing:border-box!important;
}

html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .quick-name,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) #cdqTopActionsV2204 > .cdq-top-action span{
  min-width:0!important;
  max-width:100%!important;
  white-space:normal!important;
  overflow-wrap:anywhere!important;
  text-align:center!important;
}

html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .company-menu{
  left:0!important;
  right:0!important;
  width:100%!important;
  max-width:100%!important;
  box-sizing:border-box!important;
}

html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .file-row,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .folder-header,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .file-info,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .file-name,
html:is(.android,.ios,.mobile-device) .folder-name{
  min-width:0!important;
  max-width:100%!important;
  box-sizing:border-box!important;
}
</style>

<script id="cdqV2220ViewportLockJs">
(function(){
"use strict";

function fitV2220(){
  if(typeof cdqFitGeneralScaleV92==="function" && typeof cdqGeneralValueV89==="function"){
    cdqFitGeneralScaleV92(cdqGeneralValueV89());
  }
}

window.addEventListener("load",function(){
  setTimeout(fitV2220,80);
  setTimeout(fitV2220,500);
},{once:true});

window.addEventListener("orientationchange",function(){
  setTimeout(fitV2220,180);
},{passive:true});

window.addEventListener("resize",function(){
  clearTimeout(window.__cdqV2220ResizeTimer);
  window.__cdqV2220ResizeTimer=setTimeout(fitV2220,120);
},{passive:true});

if(window.visualViewport){
  visualViewport.addEventListener("resize",function(){
    clearTimeout(window.__cdqV2220ViewportTimer);
    window.__cdqV2220ViewportTimer=setTimeout(fitV2220,120);
  },{passive:true});
}
})();
</script>

notes: Viewport basé sur la barre du bas réelle
Largeur visuelle verrouillée avec 10 px de marge
Grilles 4 colonnes et compagnie bornées à 100 %
